Class OrderItem

java.lang.Object
app.model.OrderItem
public class OrderItem extends Object
Immutable details for one menu-item line within a customer order.

  • Constructor Details

    • OrderItem

      public OrderItem(int itemId, int quantity, BigDecimal unitPrice, int sugarLevel, String iceLevel, List<Mod> mods)
      Creates an order line and copies its modification list.
      Parameters:
      itemId - identifier of the menu item
      quantity - number of units ordered
      unitPrice - base menu price per unit at sale time, excluding modifications
      sugarLevel - selected sugar level
      iceLevel - selected ice level
      mods - modifications selected for the item
      Throws:
      NullPointerException - if mods is null or contains a null element
